what: NEW! Plays via Wi-Fi to Ableton Note! Warm, rhythmic electronic music on the FM-1. Eight garage and house grooves with chords pumping under the kick; electric piano, sung syllables or your own chopped sample on the keys; pads for stutters and tape stops; ARP builds and drops. A black and white poster screen.
author: PolarPatch
sounds: own: CHOP's factory phrase is the firmware's own VOX voice, recorded in its simulator; everything else is synthesised
